_role: Stage G step 8a: the pre-registered parameters of the contained dynamic layer (models/tools/fiscal_dynamic.py). Committed before any debt path was run with them; dossiers/foundations/fair-financing/notes/dynamic-preregistration.md gives each one's source and why it departs from CBO or JCT where it does. Changing a value after the first run is a new registration, recorded in that note with its reason. Shown beside the conventional score, never in place of it.

symmetric._note: Applied the same way to the current-law baseline and to the plan. Reference: the FY2029 debt ratio (reading A, as the brief asks) or CBO's own baseline debt path (reading B: only the plan's difference from it, since CBO's long-term projection already carries its own debt feedback).

rate_bp_per_point.unit: basis points on interest rates per percentage point of debt held by the public above the reference

crowd_gdp_pct_per_point.unit: % of GDP, the GDP level's long-run change per percentage point of debt above the reference

channels._note: The plan only. Budget effect, % of GDP (+ lowers the deficit), at FY2040; 'start' and 'ramp' phase it in; 'y2056' (if given) is the level reached in FY2056 on a straight line from FY2040, else it holds at the FY2040 share. Its GDP effect is the budget effect over budget_share_of_gdp_change.

P-CARE.label: Child care, pre-K and paid leave: higher parental employment (DY6's basis)

P-HEALTHWORK.label: Health coverage not tied to a job: less job lock, premiums turned into wages

N-HEALTHCOV.label: Fuller health coverage lowers labor supply somewhat (CBO's ACA convention; DY2's basis)

N-CONTRIB.label: The 3.80% health contribution's marginal rate on earnings: labor supply

N-TOP.label: The top-rate stack and the corporate rows: labor supply, saving and investment (DY1's basis)

N-WEALTH.label: The wealth tax: avoidance and saving at the top beyond the conventional allowance

P-IMM.label: Immigration: legalization raises measured employment and wages (DY8's basis)

P-WORK.label: Work: paid on-ramps and the labor bill's participation effects (beyond LAB-1, which is booked)

P-INVEST.label: Clean power, infrastructure and R&D: productivity (DY7's basis)

works_as_designed._note: Labeled 'works as designed' (DEC-2026-11-24-14 direction 1), not dynamic. Never counted toward a debt goal (the hard rule).

WAD-H1.label: The single plan's gross cost grows below D2's cap (GDP + 1 point from FY2037), measured against the D2-held path so D2 isn't counted twice
